title: Trailing whitespace of a stored scheduler task text is lost across a restart
description:
The Scheduler Agent saves each stored task as an AGENT_SCHEDULER_ADD_TASK change in its configuration, and the configuration reader trims trailing whitespace of text values. A task whose text ends with a newline (the usual case) is therefore restored without it, so the text a client downloads from AGENT_SCHEDULER_TASK_<n> after a restart differs from the uploaded one by its trailing whitespace. Scheduling is not affected; the header and the body are unchanged. Owner chose on 2026-11-14 to record this only. Options for later: trim trailing whitespace on upload and edit so the text is the same before and after a restart, or document it.
